subjects.title: Identity preservation
subjects.text: Preserve the model's identity exactly from reference image 1; retain natural recognizable likeness.

subjects.title: Skin realism
subjects.text: Use authentic skin texture, fine facial hair, subtle under-eye detail, believable lip texture, and premium retouching without smoothing reality.

subjects.title: Hair fidelity
subjects.text: Preserve hairstyle essence and hairline; retain natural strands and realistic flyaways.

wardrobeProps.title: Polo color
wardrobeProps.text: Recreate the exact original polo color tone with accurate white balance and no hue shift.

wardrobeProps.title: Collar construction
wardrobeProps.text: Match collar construction, ribbing, fold, and collar stand exactly.

wardrobeProps.title: Placket and buttons
wardrobeProps.text: Match placket construction, button count, spacing, and button finish exactly.

wardrobeProps.title: Sleeves and shoulders
wardrobeProps.text: Match sleeve length, shoulder fit, sleeve ribbing, and armhole construction.

wardrobeProps.title: Fabric texture
wardrobeProps.text: Render the true fabric weave, thickness, drape, and tactile texture in high detail.

wardrobeProps.title: Seams and hems
wardrobeProps.text: Keep seams, stitching, hem finish, and side construction fully accurate and readable.

wardrobeProps.title: Branding and labels
wardrobeProps.text: Replicate visible branding, embroidery, print, and label placement only where shown in the references.

wardrobeProps.title: Bottomwear
wardrobeProps.text: Pair with refined neutral bottomwear that supports the polo without distracting from it.

wardrobeProps.title: Footwear
wardrobeProps.text: Use minimal premium footwear with a clean silhouette and no oversized branding.

wardrobeProps.title: Accessories
wardrobeProps.text: Use understated accessories only if they do not interfere with collar, placket, or garment visibility.

wardrobeProps.title: Visibility rule
wardrobeProps.text: Keep the polo as visual hero; avoid hands, hair, props, or accessories covering key details.
